name: Butn Limited
summary: Butn Limited is an Australian company offering transactional funding to small and medium-sized businesses. Its products are Butn Pay for managing payments with flexible repayment, Butn Now for instant access to earned commissions, Butn X for immediate payment on delivery, Butn Terms for outsourcing receivables management, and Butn Plus for secured business loans, covering factoring, supply chain finance and commission advances.
